defects.description: escapeHtml leaves the single quote untouched, so a value inside a single-quoted attribute such as renderTitle breaks out of the attribute.
defects.why_missed: Every suite value avoids the apostrophe and the title test uses a plain word, so the one attribute context that depends on the missing character is never exercised.

defects.description: escapeHtml re-escapes an ampersand that already starts an entity, so a value escaped at one layer and escaped again renders as &amp;.
defects.why_missed: The suite escapes each value once; applying the function twice is a property the contract states and no single-call test can observe.
